data.name: PasswordsHeldTooltip
data.value: Password Synchronization is switched off on this Connected System, so the change is being kept rather than attempted. Switching it on delivers everything that accumulated, unless it expires first.

data.name: PasswordsCancelShownConfirm
data.value: Stop delivering the {0} shown? Each of those people keeps their old password on the target system until a new change is synchronized. Any that is the first password of a Connected System Object JIM provisioned leaves that Connected System Object without a password from JIM.

data.name: ExchangeRefusedTooltip
data.value: JIM did not ask Exchange to make these, because what is declared cannot be made, such as a mailbox on a contact, or is a change of recipient type JIM does not make. Retrying cannot help. Correct what is declared for the account, and the next synchronization replaces the change.
